cards.title: Sparse Sampling Design and Estimation Efficiency
cards.claim: The quality of compartment model estimates depends on experimental design. Sparse sampling designs can be evaluated via stochastic simulation and estimation. In the cited study, designs with 3 points per subject required 60 subjects (180 total collections) and 4 points required 50 subjects to achieve >90% success rates in distinguishing the simulated two-compartment model with absorption lag from its no-lag counterpart. Two-point designs did not achieve this success rate even with increased sample size for that comparison in the simulated scenarios; these counts are not universal minimum sampling requirements.
limitations: Efficiency depends on the specific drug and model structure
Sparse designs may obscure absorption-phase details

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
